questions.question: What language adds interactivity to web pages?
questions.explanation: JavaScript makes web pages interactive and dynamic.

questions.question: Which keyword declares a variable that cannot be reassigned?
questions.explanation: const creates constants that cannot be reassigned.

questions.question: What function displays output in the browser console?
questions.explanation: console.log outputs messages to the browser console.

questions.question: What data type represents true or false?
questions.explanation: Boolean represents true or false values.

questions.question: Which operator checks equality without type conversion?
questions.explanation: === checks both value and type equality.

questions.question: What structure repeats code while a condition is true?
questions.explanation: Loops repeat code blocks based on conditions.

questions.question: Which method adds an element to the end of an array?
questions.explanation: push adds elements to the end of arrays.

questions.question: What object manipulates HTML elements?
questions.explanation: The DOM represents the document structure for manipulation.

questions.question: Which event fires when an element is clicked?
questions.explanation: onclick triggers when elements are clicked.

questions.question: What keyword defines a function?
questions.explanation: function keyword declares functions in JavaScript.

questions.question: Which keyword declares a block-scoped variable?
questions.explanation: let declares variables limited to their enclosing block.

questions.question: Which method removes the last element from an array?
questions.explanation: pop removes and returns the last array element.

questions.question: Which operator compares values WITH type conversion?
questions.explanation: == coerces operand types before comparing.

questions.question: Which function shows a popup message box?
questions.explanation: alert displays a modal message dialog to the user.

questions.question: Which method joins array elements into one string?
questions.explanation: join concatenates array items using a separator.

questions.question: What does NaN stand for?
questions.explanation: NaN marks a value that is not a valid number.

questions.question: Which method converts a JSON string into an object?
questions.explanation: JSON.parse turns JSON text into JavaScript objects.

questions.question: Which keyword exits a loop immediately?
questions.explanation: break terminates the nearest enclosing loop.

questions.question: Which property returns the number of items in an array?
questions.explanation: length reports how many elements an array holds.

questions.question: Which operator assigns a value to a variable?
questions.explanation: = is the assignment operator in JavaScript.

questions.question: Which event fires when the page finishes loading?
questions.explanation: onload triggers after the page and resources load.

questions.question: Which data type stores text values?
questions.explanation: Strings hold sequences of characters.

questions.question: Which method finds the first element matching a CSS selector?
questions.explanation: querySelector returns the first element matching a selector.

questions.question: What value does a declared but unassigned variable hold?
questions.explanation: Unassigned variables default to undefined.

questions.question: Which loop iterates over an object's property keys?
questions.explanation: for...in enumerates an object's keys.

questions.question: Which method attaches an event handler to an element?
questions.explanation: addEventListener registers event callbacks on elements.
